batting.dismissal: c L Balaji b M Ntini

batting.name: DB Ravi Teja
batting.dismissal: c A Mukund b JA Morkel

batting.name: Shahid Afridi
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b L Balaji

batting.name: RP Singh
batting.dismissal: c JA Morkel b L Balaji

batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: c Shahid Afridi b PM Sarvesh Kumar

balls.text: Morkel's taken a catch that scraped the sky before coming down, RP backed away to the leg side, Balaji bowled a slower ball which followed him, RP swung hard and lofted the ball miles in the air, Morkel ran in from the boundary towards midwicket, settled under the steepler and fell to his left as he completed the catch
he waits on the back foot and pushes the ball towards point for one

caught! Balaji gives Afridi a nice full toss and thigh height, Afridi comes down the track and swings hard at the ball, he connects with the bottom off his bat and lofts the ball straight to Raina at long-off, that was a loose ball and Afridi failed to cash in
RP charges and swings again, he misses this time and Afridi runs the bye to Parthiv
RP's strike-rate has dipped from 600 to 500, he swings hard at a short and wide ball and gets a top edge over the keeper for four more
full and wide outside off stump, Afridi reaches out for it and hits the ball to deep point, he missed out there and he's not on strike any more
smashed! What a shot from RP off his first ball, he backs away to make room and  lofts a length delivery with a baseball-swing back over Morkel's head for a sizable six
bowled him! Morkel greets Arjun Yadav with the yorker homing into leg stump, Yadav stays in his crease and tries to hit across the line, he misses and leg stump takes a battering

Rao's run out! It's the slower ball and Rao pulls towards deep backward square leg, the first run is easy but Rao wants to come back for the second, Gony fields and fires the throw on the bounce to Parthiv who breaks the stumps with his bat exactly on the line
caught! Teja backs away to a short ball, it hurries on to Teja who top-edges the pull high in the air towards midwicket where Mukund holds his second catch, he judged it superbly
that's a sharp bouncer outside off stump, excellent ball and Teja gets completely beaten, the umpire calls it wide for height, close call
that's a length ball and Rao hits it to midwicket and races through for the single
he's hit out, Rao backs away to a full toss and pulls Morkel to the deep midwicket boundary
full ball on off stump, Rao backs away towards leg and mis-times the drive towards cover
Teja backs away towards leg and Ntini follows him, he slips down leg side and Patel dives to his left and makes a fine save, Rao steals the bye and Patel misses the run-out at the batsman's end
full delivery in the block hole, Rao backs away and hits it towards mid-on for  a single
Rao backs away towards leg and swings wildly, not too sure where he wanted to hit that, Ntini follows him with a short of a length ball and beats the bat
shorter length angling into the right-hander, Teja tries to pull but gets an edge on to his body

what a freaky shot! Teja makes room once again and slashes hard at a length delivery, he is slightly off balance and the ball flies high, extremely high, in the air over the point boundary, that is on the second tier
full ball angling into middle stump, Teja moves toward leg to make room and loft inside out over cover, he gets a thick outside edge to third man for four, streaky but he will take it

what happened there? Teja moved across his stumps to try and chip a full ball from outside off over short fine leg - the Misbah shot - instead he got a leading edge that went on the first bounce to third man
another one nearly in the block hole, Rao can only push it towards cover for a single
an excellent yorker on middle stump, Teja makes room by moving towards leg but has to defend towards the off side
too wide once again but Teja tries to hit it too hard down the ground and misses
full ball outside off stump, Teja slashes hard at it and slices the ball to third man where Ntini dives full length to his right but can't save it, that was too wide outside off
full ball in the block hole on off stump, Rao digs it out towards point for  a single, not much he can do with that length
shorter length from Morkel on middle and leg, Rao nudges towards midwicket for a single
Rao tees off! He swings his bat like a golfer and lofts a full length ball right back over Morkel's head, he's hit it dead straight for a one-bounce four
lovely yorker on off and middle, Teja digs it out via an inside edge behind square and runs a single
tight lien and length angling into off stump, Rao leans forward and pushes towards midwicket for only a single
Teja moves across once again and nudges the ball off his pads towards square leg
Teja walks across his stumps and tries to play the leg glance but Morkel strays down leg side, another wide
Teja moves back and across and cuts a good length ball hard towards third man, he's placed it slightly wide of the fielder and will get two
Teja takes a step out of his crease, realises he isn't to the pitch of the ball and defends on the off side
Rao strides forward and opens the face to steer the ball wide of the man at short third man
driven off the front foot towards long-on for a only a single
defended towards point off the front foot
clever! Teja moves back in his crease, waits for the ball to nearly pass him before cutting it fine of Fleming at short third man
played off the pads behidn square leg
short and wide outside off stump, Teja gets into position on the back foot and cuts fiercely towards the backward point boundary
guided to third man off the back foot for a single
amazing strike! Rao makes a motion as if to move towards leg, Balaji delivers a full ball just outside off, Rao stays where he is, gets under the ball and lofts it flat over the extra cover boundary
short of a length delivery outside off stump, Teja moves back and runs the ball to third man
Teja moves back to a short ball and pulls along the ground to deep square leg
short of a length outside off stump, Teja sways out of the way and lets it go
Teja takes a step down and hits Murali with the turn towards wide long-on where Gony runs to his right and stops the ball from going over the boundary with one hand
quicker and straighter on middle stump, defended off the back foot towards the off side
a bit more air outside off, Teja plays off the back foot through cover
bowled flatter through the air on off stump, Rao plays the ball towards short third man, he hesitates in going for the run but manages to complete it in the end
Teja moves forward and pushes the ball from middle stump towards midwicket
Rao leans forward and across and uses Murali's angle into him to nudge the ball off his pads wide of the fielder at short fine leg
full and straight from Morkel, driven down the ground for one more
driven towards mid-off for a single

Rao drops the ball with soft hands towards point, he sets off for the run but Raina gets to the ball quickly, Teja sends Rao back and he has to hurry to beat Raina's underarm throw, Raina misses and concedes an over throw
good length delivery angling into off stump, Teja moves back and pushes the ball on the off side for a sharp single
a fuller ball slants into middle and leg, Rao moves forward and tries to defend but gets an inside edge on to the pad, they run a single in the direction of short gully
full toss outside off stump, it's on to Rao a bit quicker than he expected and he pushes it to cover
full ball but it's too wide outside off, Rao begins to reach out for it but checks his shot
swept down to long leg for a single to end the over
Rao tries to defend a straighter one off the back foot and gets beaten, he was playing for the turn
flatter and faster ball outside off stump, Teja picks the doosra off the pitch and pushes the ball through point off the back foot
he gets a long stride forward and blocks on the off side
tossed up on off stump, defended on the off side
bowled him! Styris takes a step down the track and tries to loft Murali with the turn over the leg side, he misses and Murali hits middle stump

dropped! Styris tries to pull a short ball from outside off stump and top edges it high towards long leg, Ntini runs to his right on the boudnary but doesn't quite get there, he certainly had plenty of time, he seems to be saying that he lost it in the lights
better line outside off stump, Styris walks down to throw the bowler off his length but he ends up defending towards the off side
that's too straight, on leg stump, that's not on when fine leg is in the circle, Styris moves across and flicks the ball past the man at short fine leg
Balaji pitches on a good length and seams the ball into the right-hander, Styris gets cramped for room as he moves forward and he defends towards point
short of a length delivery cuts into the right-hander, Rao waits on the back foot and cuts towards third man
short an wide outside off stump, asking for a hammering, Rao tries to hit it too hard and bottom edges it into the ground to the keeper
Rao gets a long stride forward and opens the face to play the ball towards short third man for one
that's the quicker doosra outside off stump, Rao pushes forward and gets beaten
flat ball and a trifle too short, Styris moves back and across and flicks the ball towards long leg
played off the pads behind square for one more
Murali fires another flat ball down leg side, that's the second wide, it's Murali's 19th and he's tied with Sreesanth for the most wides in the competition
Rao opens the face to run the doosra towards third man for two runs
bowled flat through the air on off and middle, Rao defends on the off side off the front foot
he starts off with a wide down leg side
Styris moves back and defends a good length ball towards point, Rao hares down the pitch for a run but Styris calls early and sends him back

Rao moves forward and across and tries to work the ball on the leg side, I think he gets an inside edge on to the pad and the ball drops on the pitch, Styris calls Rao through for a quick single, excellent running
tight line and length, angling into off stump from just outside, Rao moves forward and plays the ball towards point
Styris moves forward and pushes the ball towards mid-off for another single
shot! Styris takes two steps down the pitch and swings a length ball across the line to the deep midwicket boundary, lovely placement
excellent length from Gony, angling into the right-hander from off stump, Rao gets hit high on the bat as he tries to defend off the front foot and he runs a single towards the off side
that's too full on leg stump, Styris leans forward and across and clips the ball off hid pads between midwicket and mid-on for four to end the over
Rao gets on to the back foot and pushes the ball towards point for a quick single
Rao moves back and tries to steer the ball to third man an gets beaten
fuller length on off stump, pushed towards mid off for a quick single
full ball angling into the right-hander, Styris gets hit on the pad outside the line of off stump and the ball runs towards third man for four leg byes
full and wide outside off stump, Rao slashes and slices the ball over point, Ntini runs across on the boundary and fields, excellent effort for the ball was racing towards the boundary
Rao moves back, waits for the good length ball to angle into him and then opens the face to guide the ball to third man
better length from Gony, slightly shorter and angling into the right-hander, Rao defends on the back foot
that's a length delivery outside off stump, Rao moves on to the front foot, gets under the ball and lofts over cover for four, he's struck that well
Rao comes forward and tries to hit a good length ball down the ground, he gets an inside edge that runs through the gap at square leg
good length outside the off stump, Rao pokes at it off the back foot but misses
shocking fielding, from Morkel that too, Gony bowls a full ball angling into the right hander, Styris nudges the ball off his pads towards midwicket where Morkel lets it go straight through him
Ntini pitches short of a length and seams the ball into the right-hander, Rao tries to steer the ball down to third man from his crease and gets beaten
Styris takes a step forward and pushes a good length ball towards mid-on for a quick single
Rao moves forward and opens the face to steer Ntini behind point, he met the ball as it angled into him off a good length from outside off stump
short of a length delivery outside off stump, Styris jumps back in his crease and steers the ball towards third man
Styris strides on to the front foot and pushes a good length ball which angles into him towards cover
fuller length angling into the right-hander, Styris stays in his crease and closes the face to play the ball to square leg
a short of a length delivery bounces sharply on Rao who stays on the back foot and lifts his bat out of the way
good length once again outside off stump, Rao drives off the front foot, he is trying to hit towards cover but gets beaten
tight line and length on off and middle stump, Rao defends back to the bowler off the front foot

he's gone this time! Gilchrist tries to loft a good length ball down the ground but gets an outside edge that swirls high in the air towards third man, the under-19 player Abhinav Mukund initially mis-judges it but in the end he dives forward to take a sharp low catch, Deccan in serious trouble now
Gilchrist goes airborne but doesn't hit it well, he tries to loft down the ground through the line of the ball but just manages to clear Balaji at mid-off
Gilchrist moves back to drive a good length ball from off stump towards the off side but gets an inside edge on to the pad
excellent lift from Ntini, he gets the ball to rear up sharply from just short of a length, the ball angles into the right-hander and Styris lets it pass by swaying his head out of the way
short of a length from Ntini on middle and off stump, he cramps Gilchrist for room and the batsman jumps on to the back foot and drops the ball with soft hands to sprint the single
fuller length this time on off stump, Styris steers the ball towards third man to get off the mark
short of a length angling into the right-hander, Styris stands on the back foot and cuts to point

caught! The length is short and the line wide outside off stump, Gibbs slashes hard at the ball and slices it hard and flat down to third man where Balaji takes a few steps forward from the boudnary and holds on to the catch
shot! The length isn't that short but Gibbs moves back very quickly and pulls the ball with lovely use of his wrists to the long-leg boundary
Gony pitches on a good length on off stump and seams the ball back into Gibbs who tries to flick but gets hit high on the pad
Gibbs tries to launch a good length ball down the ground once again and this time he slices the ball over the in-field at cover, the outfield is very quick and the ball rolls to the boundary
that's a rash shot, Gibbs charges down the track and swings wildly, gony bowls a short of a length ball and beats the bat

Gibbs moves forward and across and tries to flick a good length ball from middle stump, he misses and gets hit on the pad in front of middle, Gony appeals and it's a very close shout, that's pretty plumb
too full once again outside off but once again Gilchrist can't find the gap at cover with the front foot drive, Dhoni is certainly hobbling
starts off with a full ball nearly in the block hole outside off stump, Gilchrist drives the ball from his crease to cover point
tight line and length angling into off stump from just outside, Gibbs strides forward and pushes towards cover
defended on the front foot towards the off side
vicious ball, Ntini gets one to bounce sharply off a good length and Gibbs was caught by surprise on the front foot, he did well to not get any bat on it as it reared past his shoulder
hits a good length once again and angles into the right-hander, Gibbs takes a stride forward and lets it go
good length once again around off stump, Gilchrist pushes the ball off the back foot towards cover and sprints the single
pitches on a good length around off stump and slants across the left-hander, Gilchrist moves back in his crease and lets the ball go through to Parthiv, who is keeping today

Raina's won it with a six! Chennai are in the semi-finals and Raina's got his 50 as well, he gets down on one knee to a length ball, gets under it, and lofts the ball cleanly over the long-on boundary, the other Super Kings rush in to mob Raina
length ball angling across the left-hander, Morkel swings across the line and mis-times the ball to midwicket where Ojha dives and stops the ball
fantastic bouncer to end the over, RP takes Raina by surprise and he can't connect with the hook
full toss outside off stump, Morkel drives the ball to long-off for a single, seven off seven needed now
that's lucky for Chennai! Morkel swings across the line at a good length ball and gets an inside edge that misses his stumps by inches and runs to the fine leg boundary
full length ball outside off, driven hard to long-off for only a single
Morkel drives the ball square through point and he's placed it well, the fielder saves the boundary but the batsmen run three because the fielder has pushed the ball some distance away from him

dropped, Raina smashes a length ball straight back to RP who can't hold on, that was hit so hard and it was a tough chance, the ball rebounds to mid-off and a direct hit at the bowler's end would have run out Raina
driven off the front foot to long-off for a single

Raina tries to hit through the leg side and mis-hits it to square leg, Afridi runs in from the deep and his throw is poor, it's high over the stumps which allows Raina to come back safely for the second
it's another full toss and this time Raina lofts the ball into the gap at deep midwicket for four, well placed
full ball in the block hole, Morkel drives hard and straight to Ojha who lets the ball go straight through him for four
Ojha's escaped here, it's a full toss and Raina hits it to deep midwicket for only a single, he should have put it away
Raina's safe! He drives the ball firmly off the front foot to deep cover, Sarvesh throws the ball to Gilchrist who breaks the stumps, Raina was just home
a hat-trick of dot balls, Morkel cuts hard off the back foot but can't beat point, a bit of pressure building and the crowd love it
Morkel moves on to the front foot and pushes towards point, another dot ball
good length ball on off stump, driven firmly off the front foot but straight to cover
Raina moves back and across and nudges off his pads towards midwicket
good length ball on off stump, pushed towards point for one
good length ball from over the wicket, it's the slower ball and Raina drives off the front foot to long-off
another ball in the block hole, Morkel pushes off the front foot towards cover once again
bowled full into the block hole from over the wicket, Morkel defends on the front foot towards cover
Raina moves back, waits for Ojha to angle the ball into him, and punches towards point for a single
Morkel takes a step forward and drives the ball to long-on for a single

caught! Dhoni takes a step out of his crease and hits the ball flat and hard towards long on where Gibbs moves quickly to his left and holds a sharp catch, that was hit extremely hard and the ball travelled quickly to Gibbs
Raina tries to loft Ojha down the ground but slices the ball over cover for a single
full delivery in the block hole outside off, Raina backs away and digs the ball out towards point for a single
over-pitched delivery angling into off and middle stump, Dhoni swats the ball down to Gibbs at long-on
the low full toss, Vijaykumar was looking for the yorker, Dhoni digs it out past the bowler and Raina sprints back for the second to the danger end, RP was slow in getting to the ball
full delivery outside off stump, Raina drives firmly off the front foot and Dhoni ducks at the non-striker's end to let the ball pass over him to long-off where Gibbs fields
good length once again just outside off, Dhoni cuts off the back foot through cover point for a single
good length ball on off stump, Dhoni gets behind the line and drives back towards the bowler
a fraction short and Raina gets into position quickly on the front foot and pulls flat and far over midwicket, that's a powerful shot
defended off the front foot
Afridi appeals for lbw after Raina misses the flick but it pitched outside leg

Dhoni comes out of his crease again but isn't to the pitch of the ball, he defends on the leg side and Raina wants the single, Dhoni sends him back, Afridi runs to the ball and shies at the bowler's end to concede an overthrow
Dhoni charges down the track to a flighted delivery and hammers the ball straight at umpire Sahiba who does well to move out of the way, the ball races to the boundary
Raina moves back and across to nudge the ball fine off his pads for  a single
Raina moves back and pushes the ball towards long-on for a single
pushed off the front foot towards the leg side for one more
short of a length just outside off stump, Dhoni stands in his crease and slashes hard at the ball, he cuts it over the head of short third man for four more
Raina moves back to a good length delivery which angles across him from over the wicket and punches to long-off
defended on the back foot towards the leg side
mis-hit but safe! Dhoni tries to pull Styris but top-edges it, Gibbs runs in quickly from the deep midwicket boundary but can't get to it in time
Dhoni drives hard and straight, the ball hits Raina on the pad and goes towards extra cover for a single
Dhoni steps down the track once again and flat-bats the ball towards the bowler, Ojha bowled that flat and straight
Ojha bowls down leg side once again, two wides in a row now
fired flat down leg side, wide called
huge! Dhoni jumps down the track, gets to the pitch of a flighted ball, and lofts Ojha powerfully into the second tier at long-on
bowled flatter on leg stump, Raina moves across and nudges off his pads towards short fine leg
tossed up on middle stump, Dhoni strides forward and drives powerfully to long-off
Dhoni moves back and cuts a flat ball from off stump to short third man
full ball on middle and leg, Dhoni leans forward and flicks off his pads to deep midwicket
Dhoni moves back in his crease to a good length ball and pushes towards the bowler
Raina moves across his crease and nudges a good length ball off his pads towards square leg for a single
good length delivery on off stump, Raina waits in his crease and drives on the up back to the bowler
full length once again around off stump, Dhoni drives off the front foot to long-off
full ball outside off stump, Dhoni reaches out for it and drives with power to deep point where Yadav fumbles to allow the second
driven towards long-off this time for a single
too short and Dhoni pulls the ball hard off the back foot to wide long-on
Dhoni tries to flick a full ball that drifts into him but misses and gets hit on the pad
Raina moves back and punches the ball to long-on for a single
bowled flat on middle stump, driven off the front foot towards the leg side
defended off the pads on the leg side
defended on the front foot towards the leg side
short and wide outside off stump, Dhoni cuts hard and places the ball fine to the third man boundary

dropped! Sarvesh bowls a short of a length ball outside off stump, Dhoni moves back and drives the ball in the air right back at the bowler, it wasn't hit very hard and the ball flew to Sarvesh's right, he just couldn't react quickly enough, big let off
short, wide, smashed and caught! Parthiv stays in his crease and tries to cut a short of a length ball off the front foot towards cover, he hits it hard but straight to Afridi who takes a sharp catch
Parthiv charges down the track and swings wildly at the ball, he doesn't make contact
short and wide outside off stump, cut off the back foot  through point, Raina completes the first run and then slips as he turns for the second
nudged off the pads for  a single
another one down leg side, another wide
that's rather wide down leg side
driven in the air but over Afridi's head for a single
punched off the back foot towards cover

Raina tries to sweep but gets hit on the pad and loses balance, the ball goes towards short fine leg and Parthiv runs the single, had there been a direct hit at the bowler's end Raina would have been out
bowled quicker and flatter outside off, Raina tries to cut but misses
tossed up on middle stump, Parthiv strides forward and drives to deep midwicket for a single
defended towards point off the back foot
well he's hit this with tremendous power! Raina backs away towards leg, makes room and smashes the ball with a flat ball over the bowler's head, it bounces once before racing over the boundary
Raina tries to pull the ball which hurries on to him and he mis-hits it in the air but over the head of mid-on, the ball then runs to the long-on boundary
tight line and length on middle and off, Raina waits in his crease and punches on the off side
good length once again on middle and off, Parthiv pushes the ball towards mid-on for a single
good length delivery pitches around off stump and slants across the left-hander, Parthiv swings hard at the ball but misses
Raina tries to pull a quicker ball that isn't short enough and gets beaten outside off stump
Raina moves forward and tries to turn the ball off his pads, he misses and gets hit in front of the stumps, Afridi appeals for lbw but the ball pitched outside leg
Parthiv gets his front foot forward and across and sweeps the ball to long leg
Raina pushes the ball on the leg side and calls for the quick single
swept down to long leg for one
Parthiv tries to sweep across the line of a delivery that drifts across off stump, he misses and Gilchrist breaks the stumps, Parthiv just manages to get his back foot behind the line
short of a length outside off stump, Parthiv punches through covers for a single
RP strays down leg side once again, another wide
an excellent short ball but Parthiv watches it all the way and sways out of the line to let the ball go, well played
defended on the back foot towards the off side
better length outside the off stump, Parthiv lets it go this time
short and wide outside off stump, terrible line and length, Parthiv waits on the back foot and tries to cut, he gets a bottom edge past slip to the third man boundary
fuller delivery angling into Parthiv who strides forward and punches back to the bowler
defended off the front foot on the off side
fuller length this time outside off stump but Raina improvises and alters the length by moving back to create the right length to punch the ball through cover for four more
short and wide outside off stump, poor ball, Raina moves back and slaps the ball in the air but over cover for his first boundary
that's a bit too wide outside off  from Vijaykumar and he concedes an extra
Raina tries to slash the ball from wide outside off stump and gets beaten, ambitious shot off your first ball

caught! He pitches on a good length outside off stump, Fleming sees a lot of width and goes after it, trying to drive hard through cover, he gets a thick outside edge through to Gilchrist who takes a comfortable catch
short of a length outside off stump, Fleming stands tall on the back foot and cuts the ball into the gap at cover point, the ball races to the boundary, Chennai are finding it regularly
good length delivery in the channel outside off, Parthiv tries to drive on the up through cover but gets beaten
that's too short, way too short and the ball doesn't bounce much this time, Parthiv swivels across his stumps and pulls over midwicket for four, he hit that so sweetly
that's a sharp short ball from RP, angling into the left-hander, Parthiv sways out of the way and lets it pass
he tries to hit on the leg and gets an edge towards the off
Parthiv tries to cut a a short of a length ball that gets big on him and cramps him for room, he gets an bottom edge into the ground, Gilchrist dives to his right and makes the save
punched off the front foot back to the bowler
superb save from the substitute Chamara Silva, Parthiv cuts a short and wide ball with power in front of point where Silva dives to his left and saves three runs
shot! The width is there to cut and Parthiv times the shot superbly but can't beat the in-field at point
fuller length outside off stump, Fleming pushes towards point off the front foot and sprints the single
the ball bounces a bit more off a good length, Fleming stands in his crease and tries to cut but gets beaten by the high bounce
defended on the front foot towards mid-off
the half-volley outside off stump, Fleming strides forward and drives the ball firmly through cover point for four
defended on the back foot towards the bowler
excellent control from Parthiv, the short ball gets big on him but he manages to get on top of the bounce and guide the ball towards the fine leg boundary
pushed off the front foot in front of point for  a single
banged in short down leg side once again

dropped! The short of a length delivery angles into Fleming and takes off sharply off the pitch, the ball seams away from the left-hander and Fleming fends at it at the last moment, the ball goes off the outside edge between the keeper and Styris at first slip, no body moved, Gilchrist is late to react
short of a length once again on off stump, Fleming stays on the back foot and blocks
short of a length delivery keeps Parthiv on the back foot, he nudges the ball towards the leg side for a quick single
RP bangs the short ball down leg side, he starts with a wide
